snippet.title: Vivarium Official Trailer | #TheIndiePremier
snippet.description:
Awaken in an endless summer and explore a seemingly perfect miniature world. Discover hidden secrets and shape a non-linear story as you unravel the mysteries of this nostalgic pocket universe.

Developed by Studio Meadowflower and published by Serenity Forge.
